# Fixture: mountinfo fields containing escaped characters. mountinfo escapes
# spaces (\040), tabs (\011) and newlines (\012) in the root and mount point.
# Known defect (current behavior): parse_mountinfo_for_line does NOT unescape,
# so the mount points below parse as the literal strings "my\040dir" and
# "tab\011dir" instead of "my dir" and "tab<TAB>dir". The expected result is
# recorded as-is so Phase 1 can fix the parser and update this test.
60 26 0:26 / /sys/fs/cgroup/my\040dir rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime shared:20 - cgroup cgroup rw,memory
61 26 0:27 / /sys/fs/cgroup/tab\011dir rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime shared:21 - cgroup cgroup rw,memory
